scope: Single ordinary-path screening experiment; no physical acceptance, native qualification, final repeats, or production adoption. Prepared solver mass metric is not a complete physical energy ledger.
protocol:
Artifact-only passive joint warm-cache experiment, predeclared before execution.
Ordinary path first; original hip and severe initial states, 120 steps each, unchanged scene/body/joint/default settings, step size and substeps. Baseline must reproduce previous baseline body streams byte-exact. Initial getters exact; complete finite frame/body/joint observations mandatory.
Candidate uses prepared solver inertia metric L alpha + Q alpha^2, with largest alpha in [0,1] having nonpositive change. This is a numerical cache-guess guard, NOT a bound on true orientation-updated kinetic/stored energy. Uses actual generalized cached impulse, avoids inertia inversion. Static/sleep/fixed rotation contributions handled by existing writability/tensor flags. All cache components and applied impulse scale together; live revolute axis caches are unchanged. Prescribed nonzero motors and kinematic endpoints excluded. CPU-compatible path unchanged.
Keep original physical Rain screens failed until independently resolved. Reject candidate if cone reduction trades for increased target anchor or all-joint twist beyond baseline numerical roundoff (1e-6 m / 1e-6 rad). No selection of a favorable subwindow. Examine all original replay metrics. No parameter/iteration sweeps.
Also run existing unmodified spherical_compliance_reference.cpp on baseline/candidate ordinary: both 0.01 and 0.1 rad loads, 600 steps, last120 max angle prediction error <1e-4 rad and max speed <1e-3 rad. Any failure rejects preservation of the existing loaded response, regardless of Rain gains. No weakening. A screening pass is not qualification: native path, isolated spring/active motor/locked inertia controls, five fresh complete-state repeats, full matrix, performance and recordings remain required before adoption.

import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,shutil
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();mode,label=sys.argv[1:];out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/f'{label}-{mode}';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
include=root.parents[1]/'box3d/include';shared=root.parents[1]/'box3d/shared';commands=[]
def run(cmd):
 commands.append([str(x) for x in cmd]);subprocess.run(commands[-1],check=True)
objects=[]
for name in ['human','utils']:
 obj=out/(name+'.o');run(['cc','-O2','-DNDEBUG','-ffunction-sections','-fdata-sections','-I',include,'-I',shared,'-c',shared/(name+'.c'),'-o',obj]);objects.append(obj)
cpulib=root/'native-samples/build-both-native-cache-portable/libbox3d_cpu_original.a';libs=[cpulib];extra=[]
if mode!='cpu':
 lib=out.parent/'candidate-libgpu_physics.a' if label=='candidate' else out.parent/'baseline-libgpu_physics.a';libs.insert(0,lib)
 stub=out/'stubs.o';run(['cc','-O2','-I',include,'-c',root/'c_abi/samples_stubs.c','-o',stub])
 api=root/'native-samples'/('build-gpu' if mode=='ordinary' else 'build-gpu-native-cache')/'libgpu_samples_api.a';libs.insert(0,api)
 extra=['-Wl,--allow-multiple-definition','-Wl,--wrap=b3CreateCompound','-Wl,--whole-archive',api,'-Wl,--no-whole-archive',lib,stub]
run(['g++','-O2','-DNDEBUG','-std=c++17','-Wl,--gc-sections',root/'c_abi/rain_cell_reference.cpp','-I',include,'-I',shared,*objects,*extra,cpulib,'-ldl','-lpthread','-lm','-lgcc_s','-lGL','-o',out/'fixture'])
digest=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
(out/'source.patch').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--','src','shaders','c_abi','scripts']))
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(mode=mode,label=label,commands=commands,binary_sha256=digest(out/'fixture'),libraries={str(p):digest(p) for p in libs},shader_sha256=digest(root/'shaders/physics/solve.wgsl')),indent=2)+'\n')
sources.run.py:
import os,subprocess,json,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
for case,row,column,base in [('hip','3','9','3907'),('severe','9','1','4999')]:
 for arm in ['baseline','candidate']:
  out=root/f'{case}-{arm}';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
  fixture=root/f'{arm}-ordinary/fixture'
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('GPU_PHYSICS_','WGPU_','RAIN_'))}
  env.update(RAIN_CELL_ROW=row,RAIN_CELL_COLUMN=column,RAIN_REPLAY_BASE=base,RAIN_REPLAY_STATE=str(root/f'{case}-initial.txt'),RAIN_REPLAY_LIMITS='1',RAIN_REPLAY_HEALTH='1',RAIN_REPLAY_COLLISIONS='1',GPU_PHYSICS_LIVE_CONTACT_ORDER='0',WGPU_BACKEND='vulkan',GPU_PHYSICS_PIPELINE_CACHE_DIR=str(Path.home()/'.cache/box3d-gpu-physics/pipelines'))
  command=[str(fixture),'120'];start=time.monotonic()
  (out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=command,binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),environment={k:v for k,v in env.items() if k.startswith(('GPU_','WGPU_','RAIN_'))}),indent=2))
  with (out/'state.txt').open('w') as stdout,(out/'run.log').open('w') as stderr:r=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
  (out/'exit.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(exit=r.returncode,seconds=time.monotonic()-start),indent=2))
  print(case,arm,r.returncode,flush=True)
  if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
sources.build_candidate.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,shutil,hashlib,json
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
shader=Path('shaders/physics/solve.wgsl')
original=(root/'original-solve.wgsl').read_bytes()
assert shader.read_bytes()==original
try:
 shader.write_bytes((root/'candidate-solve.wgsl').read_bytes())
 with (root/'build.log').open('w') as log:
  r=subprocess.run(['cargo','build','--release','--lib','--features','replay-diagnostics'],env=__import__('os').environ|{'CARGO_BUILD_JOBS':'1'},stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 (root/'build-exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit':r.returncode}))
 if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
 shutil.copy2('target/release/libgpu_physics.a',root/'candidate-libgpu_physics.a')
finally:
 shader.write_bytes(original)
 (root/'restoration.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source_restored':shader.read_bytes()==original,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()}))

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,time,json,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
for arm in ['baseline','candidate']:
 for script in ['build_fixture.py','build_loaded.py']:
  subprocess.run(['python3',str(p/script),'ordinary',arm],check=True)
subprocess.run(['python3',str(p/'run.py')],check=True)
subprocess.run(['python3',str(p/'analyze.py')],check=True)
previous=p.parent/'rain-coupled-cone-point-experiment'
for case in ['hip','severe']:
 assert (p/f'{case}-baseline/state.txt').read_bytes()==(previous/f'{case}-baseline/state.txt').read_bytes()
print('Both baseline body streams match original exactly',flush=True)
for arm in ['baseline','candidate']:
 out=p/f'loaded-{arm}-ordinary'
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('GPU_PHYSICS_','WGPU_','RAIN_'))}
 env.update(GPU_PHYSICS_LIVE_CONTACT_ORDER='0',WGPU_BACKEND='vulkan',GPU_PHYSICS_PIPELINE_CACHE_DIR=str(Path.home()/'.cache/box3d-gpu-physics/pipelines'))
 command=[str(out/'fixture')]
 (out/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=command,binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256((out/'fixture').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),environment={k:v for k,v in env.items() if k.startswith(('GPU_','WGPU_'))}),indent=2))
 start=time.monotonic()
 with (out/'state.txt').open('w') as stdout,(out/'run.log').open('w') as stderr:
  r=subprocess.run(command,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
 (out/'exit.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(exit=r.returncode,seconds=time.monotonic()-start),indent=2))
 print('loaded',arm,r.returncode,flush=True)
